league.note: Designed league settings (M1 step 5). homeField: centered and symmetric; every home player's ratings get +ratingEdge points and every away player's -ratingEdge for the game, and offensive pre-snap foul rates are x (1 - crowdNoise) for the home offense and x (1 + crowdNoise) for the away offense. teamStrength: each generated team draws a strength shift, round(sd x a standard normal) rating points, for all its players.
